result.stdout:
Usage: kschema <command> <schema-file> [options]

Commands:
  generate <schema-file> [--generator <name>]   Run the schema's code generators.
  validate <schema-file>                        Report the schema's validation issues.

Options of kschema:
  --cpp-options <file>                          How this target spells what C++ does not.

Output paths are relative to the schema file's own directory.
Known languages: csharp, cpp
